column3: web of attachment, snare of illusion
in place, in the proper place
to dye, to colour, to paint
to be influenced, to blend in
a tiny bit, the least bit
rich in gems, full of treasures
all over the land, far and wide
land attached to a house, premises
land attached to a house, premises
small red seed (used as a weight)
dos and don'ts, injunctions and prohibitions
separated lover, one parted from a beloved
for the sky to glow red
resulting from sandhi, resulting from a treaty
to be improved, to be set right
and a quarter, one and a quarter
to be careful, to recover oneself
